sources.title: Legea nr. 2/1968, republicată (Buletinul Oficial nr. 54-55 din 27 iulie 1981)
sources.says: Republished annex lists, county by county, every town, commune and village in force on 27 July 1981; Sectorul Agricol Ilfov is subordinate to Bucharest.

sources.title: Wikidata: localities with SIRUTA code (P843) and their present county
sources.says: Gives each present-day SIRUTA locality and the county it lies in today (queried 2026-10-05; used for the village-by-village comparison with the 1981 annex).

sources.title: Administrative divisions of Romania (Wikipedia, rev. 1321342661)
sources.says: States that the only territorial adjustment after 1989 was the formation of Ilfov County from the Bucharest agricultural sector (cites an Arges prefecture history page).

spans.dateNote: 1981-07-27 is the date the county composition is attested (republication of Law 2/1968 after Decree 15/1981), not the county creation (1968). Village-by-village comparison of the 1981 annex with present SIRUTA localities found no village of this county now in another county and none from another county now in it (only name noise from merged/renamed villages); post-1989 changes were limited to Ilfov per the cited article.
